title: Parcel geometry service
publisher: Vision Government Solutions — New Haven property map service
description: Published parcel polygons and identifiers for mapping property boundaries.
access: ArcGIS service metadata; query needs testing
fields: Published account-number field; join semantics unconfirmed
steps: Open the parcel layer's service metadata page.
Inspect Fields, spatial reference, supported query formats, and Query operation.
Before integrating it, test a small read-only query and confirm identifiers and freshness.
contact: Assessor's Office for assessment information; GIS gallery lists gisadmin@newhavenct.gov. Service responsibility needs confirmation.
limitations: Metadata opened successfully; no feature query or bulk extraction has been tested.
Metadata advertises a 3,000-record response limit and pagination. One response must not be treated as the whole dataset.
Spatial reference is EPSG:2234; request or transform coordinates before treating them as latitude/longitude.
Technical access does not establish redistribution rights or a refresh schedule.
Parcel boundaries are distinct from full assessor records.
next: Test one sample query, including its coordinate output.
Verify the city's relationship to this service and clarify terms and refresh dates.

evidence.note: Field schema, polygon geometry, spatial reference, formats and record limit read directly.
City GIS gallery located through indexed search; full interactive content not inspected.
